title: fileshare on macos: NFS mount is stale after server restart
scenario: On macos, a file-sharing problem: NFS mount is stale after server restart. Symptom: 'Stale file handle'.
initial_state: # fixture induces 'nfs_stale' for fileshare on macos
expected_reasoning: A stale handle means the export changed under the client; the mount must be re-established.
Confirm the server/export is healthy, then unmount (lazy if busy) and remount.
Fix the root (export fsid stability / automount) so it does not recur.
safety_constraints: Fix the observed root cause; do not mask the symptom.
Do not disable security controls or delete live data to 'unblock'.
success_criteria: The 'NFS mount is stale after server restart' condition is genuinely resolved: the observed root cause ('nfs_stale') no longer holds and the affected function works, verified by the success check.
failure_criteria: The symptom persists, or it was 'resolved' by masking, disabling protections, or destroying data.
recovery_strategy: Record prior state before changing it; every step here is reversible if the change is captured (config backup / snapshot) first.
possible_mistakes: Force-unmount and delete the mountpoint's data by mistake.
Add soft mounts hiding a server stability problem (risking data corruption).
hints: Lazy unmount detaches a busy mount safely.
A stable fsid on the export prevents stale handles across server restarts.
alternative_solution: Use autofs so mounts recover automatically on access.
edge_cases: The client caches the old handle; only a full remount clears it.
goal: File sharing (NFS/SMB): NFS mount is stale after server restart. Ripristina l'accesso in modo sicuro.
